```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  tidy = FALSE, 
  size = "small",
  fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3) 

options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = '')

# load packages
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras2)
library(ggspatial)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(fivethirtyeight)
library(usmap)
```


```{r}
storms <- read_csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv") |> 
  filter(contiguous_us) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("BEGIN_LON", "BEGIN_LAT"), crs = 4326) |>
  arrange(desc(deaths))

us_states2 <- maps::map("state",
                     plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE) |> st_as_sf()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = us_states2) + 
  geom_sf(data = storms, aes(size = deaths, 
                             color = EVENT_TYPE2)) + labs(title = "Fatal Storms from 1950-2026")
  theme_void()
```


```{r}
storm_time <- read_csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv") |>
  filter(contiguous_us) |>
  arrange(fatality_date) |> 
  mutate(
    popup_text = paste0(
      "<b>", EVENT_TYPE, "</b><br>",
      YEAR, "<br>",
      country_zone, ", ", 
      STATE, "<br>",
      "Deaths: ", deaths)) |>                                
  st_as_sf(coords = c("BEGIN_LON", "BEGIN_LAT"), crs = 4326)      

storm_color <- colorFactor("viridis", domain = storm_time$EVENT_TYPE)

leaflet() |>
   addTiles() |>
  addTimeslider(
    data = storm_time,
    radius = ~ 3 + sqrt(deaths) * 2,              
    color = ~ storm_color(EVENT_TYPE),
    fillColor = ~ storm_color(EVENT_TYPE),
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 0.8,
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    popup = ~ popup_text,
    options = timesliderOptions(
      position = "topright",
      timeAttribute = "fatality_date",                         
      range = TRUE                            
    )
  ) |>
  setView(lng = -96, lat = 38, zoom = 4)
```
